DATED : 12th OCTOBER, 2023.
ORAL JUDGMENT Heard finally with consent of learned Advocates for the parties.
2. ADMIT.

3. In this appeal, challenge is to the judgment and award dated 20.10.2006 passed by learned Civil Judge, Senior Division -3- 48 Fa 450.23.jud. odt..odt Pusad, (hereinafter referred to as Reference Court) in L.A.C.
No.355/2002, whereby the reference application filed by the appellant was partly allowed.
4. The land bearing survey No.56 admeasuring 2H.20 R. belonging to the appellants situated at Mouza Amadapur was acquired for the purpose of Amdapur Project.

Notification under Section 4(1)
of the Land Acquisition Act was issued on 07.11.1996.
The Land Acquisition Officer passed award on 09.05.2000 and awarded compensation at the rate of Rs.30,000/- per hectare.
In the reference application, compensation was awarded at the rate of Rs.40,000/- per hectare.
Being aggrieved by the judgment and award, the appellants are before this Court.
5. I have heard Mr. A.I. Sheikh, learned Advocate for the claimants/legal heirs, Ms Deepa Charlewar, learned AGP for respondent Nos.1 and 3 and Mr. M.A. Kadu, learned Advocate for respondent Nos.2.
Perused the record and proceedings.

sentences.text: 6. Learned Advocate for the claimants/legal heirs as well as learned AGP for respondent Nos.1 and 3 submit that this appeal is covered by the decision rendered by this Court in First Appeal -4- 48 Fa 450.23.jud. odt..odt No.355 of 2018 (Ramrao Masaji Dantalwad Vs. State of Maharashtra and Ors.) decided on 10.12.2018.

entities.text: Ramrao Masaji Dantalwad Vs. State of Maharashtra and Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is pointed out that in the said appeal, the compensation awarded by this Court is at the rate of Rs.83,000/- per hectare.
7. The claimants/legal heirs land in this appeal as well as land in the above appeal are similarly situated lands.
They were from the same village and acquired for the same project.
Therefore, this appeal can be disposed of being covered by the above judgment.
8. The First Appeal is partly allowed.

9. The claimants/legal heirs are entitled to get the compensation at the rate of Rs.83,000/- (Rupees Eighty Three Thousand Only) per hectare in respect of land which is the subject matter of the appeal with interest and other statutory benefits.

10. The claimants/legal heirs will not be entitled to get interest and other benefits for delayed period of 4807 days.
 -5- 48 Fa 450.
11. The respondent No.2 shall dep balance/difference amount within twelve weeks.
12. The claimants/legal heirs are requested to pay the deficit Court fee on the enhanced amount of compensation.
If the deficit Court fee is not paid by the claimants/legal heirs, then the same shall be recovered/deducted from the enhanced compensation amount.
13. First Appeal stands disposed of.
No order as to costs.
(G. A. SANAP, J.) manisha Signed by: Mrs. Manisha Shewale Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 21/10/2023 16:04:56
